answer: Stake-gated delayed unlock: each identity locks a bond for at least four epochs; the bond unlocks only if a majority of independent peer scores on its answers stay at or above 2, and a failing epoch slashes a fixed fraction. A sybil operator must immobilize fresh stake per alias and absorb slash risk while waiting. A sparrow-sized farm cannot recycle one ember of capital across many shells, because every copy keeps its own crystal of locked, slashable funds until the delay ends.
